title: Ramsay Health Care Limited - proposed acquisition of the Coolenberg Clinic day surgery (currently closed) at Port Macquarie, NSW
targets: Coolenberg Clinic day surgery (currently closed) at Port Macquarie NSW

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 9 September 2008 amended to 16 September 2008 - to allow for further market inquiries.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.
